## About
Innovative Car Care Center is a full service automotive repair shop in Hockley, Texas. From oil changes and state inspections to engine replacements, we handle the work that keeps your car or truck on the road.
Opening a local repair shop in the Hockley/Waller area was a family dream for Jeanet Roman and her husband Emmanuel. Emmanuel started out in the automotive repair industry shadowing master technicians and learned how to run a shop from the ground up. Jeanet, a University of Houston alum, brought the business side. Together they built Innovative Car Care Center.
Our crew includes Moe (Mauricio Chaires), a Master Certified technician who keeps up with workshops and training courses. Jeremy Lovelady brings years in the industry and a spirited way with customers. Eric Castro handles state inspections, oil changes and general maintenance.
We know needing your vehicle repaired is an inconvenience, and we work to keep that inconvenience small. If a repair will take longer, we let you know as soon as possible. We also run customer shuttles to and from work or home.

## Services
- Check Engine Light Diagnosis: We use computer diagnostics to track down check engine lights, drivability issues and odd noises under the hood or under the vehicle.
- Scheduled Manufacturer Services/Maintenance: We follow your manufacturer's recommended services at the right mileage to help prevent costly repairs and keep your vehicle going.
- Free initial AC check: In the Houston area we all know how important our AC is, and we provide a free initial check out on your AC system.
- Oil Changes and Lube: Routine oil changes and lube service to keep your engine in good shape.
- Brakes: Brake service and repair for cars and trucks around Hockley.
- State inspections: Eric specializes in state inspections, along with oil changes and general maintenance.
- Battery Checks & Replacement: We check your battery and replace it when it's time.
- Engine Overhaul & Replacement: When an engine needs major work, we handle overhauls and full replacements.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We're closed on weekends.

Q: How long will my repair take?
A: We strive to get the majority of repairs done with same-day or two-day service. If a repair will take longer, we notify you as soon as possible.

Q: Can I get a ride while my car is in the shop?
A: Yes. We offer customer shuttles to and from work or home.

Q: Do you check the AC?
A: Yes. We provide a free initial check out on your AC system.

Q: What if I need a tow after hours?
A: For after hours towing, call Cy-Creek Towing at 281-859-0994.

Q: If I send a message, when will I hear back?
A: If needed, you will hear back within 48-72 hours. For anything sooner, give the shop a call.
